Rashi on Keritot 11a:11:1.english: Redeemed [and not redeemed] - "And redeemed, she was not redeemed" implies [that she is] redeemed and not redeemed.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:13:1.hebrew: לרבי ישמעאל מאורסת לעבד עברי מנא ליה - בשלמא לר"ע דמוקי לה בחציה בת חורין, לא בעיא קרא, דאיכא למימר מדחייב עלה רחמנא, ודאי מאורסת היא מישראל, דהא תפסו לה קדושין. הילכך איכא למימר לעבד עברי נתקדשה, שהרי רבו מוסרה לו בעל כרחו, כדמפרש בקדושין (דף יד:), ולא לעבד כנעני, שהרי אסורה לו. אלא לרבי ישמעאל, דאמר שפחה גמורה, מאורסת לעבד עברי מנא ליה (דאמר לעבד עברי שהרי אסורה לו), דילמא לעבד כנעני, דהא לדידיה שריא לגמרי טפי מעברי:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:13:1.english: According to Rabbi Yishmael, from where does he [derive that she is] betrothed to a Hebrew slave - Granted, according to Rabbi Akiva, who establishes it [as referring to a maidservant who is] half a freewoman, no verse is needed, for it can be said that since the Merciful One imposed liability on her account, she is certainly betrothed to an Israelite, since betrothal takes effect on her. Therefore, it can be said that she became betrothed to a Hebrew slave, since his master gives her to him against his will, as is explained in Kiddushin (14b), and not to a Canaanite slave, since she is forbidden to him. But according to Rabbi Yishmael, who says [she is] a full maidservant, from where does he [derive that she is] betrothed to a Hebrew slave (who says to a Hebrew slave, since she is forbidden to him)? Perhaps [she is betrothed] to a Canaanite slave, since to him she is completely permitted, more so than to a Hebrew [slave].

Rashi on Keritot 11a:15:1.english: If it is not [needed for the] matter of her - For it is written (Leviticus 19): "and she was redeemed, not redeemed."

Rashi on Keritot 11a:16:1.hebrew: כל העריות - אם האחד גדול, או האיש או האשה, האחד חייב והאחד פטור; ובשפחה אינו כן, ובגמרא מפרש לה:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:16:1.english: All forbidden [relations] - If one is an adult — whether the man or the woman — the one is liable and the other is exempt; but with a [betrothed] maidservant it is not so, and in the Gemara it explains it.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:16:2.hebrew: שוגג בחטאת ומזיד בהכרת - ובשפחה, נהי דאם הוא מזיד והיא שוגגת דפטורין, הואיל ואינה לוקה — כדאמרינן לעיל: "בקורת תהיה והביא את אשמו", ואי לא, פטורין — מיהו אם הוא שוגג והיא מזידה, היא במלקות והוא באשם, כדאמרי' בהאי פירקא דשוגג ומזיד שוין בבא על השפחה:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:16:2.english: One [who acts] unwittingly [is liable] to [bring] a sin offering, and one [who acts] intentionally [is liable] to karet - But regarding [an espoused] maidservant, granted that if he [acts] intentionally and she [acts] unwittingly they are exempt, since she is not flogged — as we said above: "[There shall be] an inquiry... and he shall bring his guilt offering," and if not, they are exempt — nevertheless, if he [acts] unwittingly and she [acts] intentionally, she [is liable] to flogging and he [is liable] to [bring] a guilt offering, as we say in this chapter that unwitting and intentional [offenders] are equal in [the case of] one who has intercourse with an [espoused] maidservant.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:17:1.hebrew: והכא חייב - בתמיה, וכי קטן חייב בשפחה:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:17:1.english: And here, [is a minor] liable - [This is asked] in astonishment: Is a minor liable in [the case of] a maidservant?

Rashi on Keritot 11a:17:2.hebrew: דהא איתקוש להדדי - כדאמרן לעיל, אם אין האשה לוקה, אין האיש מביא אשם:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:17:2.english: For they are juxtaposed to each other - As we said above, if the woman is not flogged, the man does not bring a guilt offering.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:18:1.english: And is [one who is] sleeping liable - [This is asked] in astonishment.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:20:1.english: One who engages in the initial stage [of intercourse] is not liable - For "emission of semen" is written regarding her.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:20:2.hebrew: וכי מכוין מיחייב, ואי לא לא מיחייב - דשכבת זרע בעינן, ושאינו מתכוין — כגון נפל מן הגג ונתקע — אין ראוי להזריע:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:20:2.english: And when he intends [it], he is liable, and if not, he is not liable - For we require [an emission of] semen, and one who does not intend [it] — such as one who fell from the roof and became lodged [in her] — is not fit to emit semen.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:22:1.hebrew: ואי בשאר עריות קתני, איפכא מיבעי ליה - עשו מערה בעריות חייב כגומר, שלא כדרכה חייב כבכדרכה, ד״משכבי אשה״ כתיב (ויקרא יט):
Rashi on Keritot 11a:22:1.english: And if [it] teaches [this] with regard to other forbidden relations, it should have [stated] the opposite - They rendered one who engages in the initial stage [of intercourse] with forbidden relations liable like one who completes [the act], [and] one [who does so] in an atypical manner liable like [one who does so] in a typical manner, for it is written: "the lyings of a woman" (Leviticus 19):

Rashi on Keritot 11a:2:1.hebrew: ר' ישמעאל אומר שפחה - גמורה:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:2:1.english: Rabbi Yishmael says: A maidservant - [a] complete [maidservant].

Rashi on Keritot 11a:2:2.hebrew: כל העריות מפורשות - שהן בנות חורין, ושיור אין לנו, וזו ודאי משונה היא — חציה שפחה וחציה בת חורין:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:2:2.english: All those with whom relations are forbidden are enumerated - [In] that they are free women, and we have no exception, and this one is certainly unusual — [one who is] half-maidservant and half-free woman.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:1.hebrew: תהא בקריאה - שהן קורין עליה ״והפלא ה' את מכותך״, שכן קורין על הלוקין במס' מכות (דף כב:):
Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:1.english: She shall be with reading - For they recite over her, "Then the Lord will make your plagues extraordinary," as they recite over those who are flogged in Tractate Makkot (22b).

Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:2.hebrew: בבקורת תהיה - שאם אינה יכולה לקבל ארבעים, אומדין אותה בבקור ובמחשבה:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:2.english: She shall be [subject] to an assessment - For if she is unable to receive forty [lashes], they assess her with examination and deliberation.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:3.hebrew: מכות הראויות להשתלש - כגון י"ח או כ"א או כ"ד, שהיו מכין אותו שתי ידות (מלפניו ואחת מאחריו), ומקרא ילפינן לה במס' מכות (דף כג.):
Rashi on Keritot 11a:4:3.english: Lashes fit to be divided by three - Such as eighteen, or twenty-one, or twenty-four, for they would strike him two parts (in front of him and one behind him), and we derive it from a verse in Tractate Makkot (23a).

Rashi on Keritot 11a:5:1.english: At the time that the woman is flogged - For she is an adult and she is subject to punishments.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:7:1.hebrew: אימא הוא מיעטיה קרא - מהדר אמתני' דקתני ״לא השוה אשה לאיש לקרבן״. אימא הוא מיעטיה קרא ממלקות, דכתיב ״תהיה״, אבל היא — אימא תילקי ותייתי קרבן:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:7:1.english: Say [that] the verse excluded him - [The Gemara] is referring back to the Mishnah, which teaches: "[Scripture] did not equate a woman to a man with respect to an offering." Say [that] the verse excluded him from lashes, as it is written, "there shall be [an inquiry]," but [as for] her — say [that] she should be flogged and bring an offering.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:8:1.english: It is an expression of change - That she has changed from her [original] creation.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:8:2.hebrew: הריפות - דבר שנשתנה ע"י כתישה, וכאן נמי ע"י אבר שמש דש:
Rashi on Keritot 11a:8:2.english: Groats - Something that was changed through pounding; and here too, [she was changed] through the [male] organ [that] copulated [and] threshed.

Rashi on Keritot 11a:9:1.english: And they gave their hand to divorce - It is a verse in the Book of Ezra.

Tosafot on Keritot 11a:17:1.hebrew: דהא מקשו להדדי - הלשון אינו מכוון, דהאיש הוקשה לאשה ולא אשה לאיש. דהא כי האיש קטן, כמו כן האשה חייבת, כדאיתא בת"כ: "ואיש" — פרט לקטן; יכול שאני מוציא בן תשע שנים ויום אחד? ת"ל "ואיש". א"כ, אשה לא איתקשה לאיש:
Tosafot on Keritot 11a:17:1.english: For they are compared to each other - The phrasing is imprecise, for the man is compared to the woman, and not the woman to the man. For when the man [is a minor], even so the woman is liable, as it is taught in Torat Kohanim: "'And a man' — [this] excludes a minor; could it be that I exclude a [boy] nine years and one day old? The verse states: 'And a man.'" If so, the woman is not compared to the man.

Tosafot on Keritot 11a:19:1.hebrew: באין מתכוין (דכדרכה) פטור - פירש הקונט' משום דש"ז כתיב, ובאין מתכוין אינו ראוי להזריע, כגון נפל מן הגג ונתקע. וקשה: מאן לימא לן דאינו ראוי להזריע? אלא האי טעמא משום שאנוס הוא:
Tosafot on Keritot 11a:19:1.english: When he is unintentional (in a typical manner) he is exempt - Rashi explained [that this is] because "shikhvat zera" [lying carnally] is written [in the verse], and when one is unintentional he is not fit to produce seed, for example, [if] he fell from the roof and became inserted. And [this is] difficult: Who tells us that he is not fit to produce seed? Rather, this reason [for his exemption] is because he is under duress.

Tosafot on Keritot 11a:5:1.hebrew: אין האשה לוקה - כגון שהיא שוגגת וקטנה, אין האיש מביא קרבן. והא דאמרינן "לרבות שוגג כמזיד", היינו שוגג דאיש כמזיד, אבל האשה צריך שתהא מזידה:
Tosafot on Keritot 11a:5:1.english: The woman is not flogged - For example, where she is unwitting or a minor, the man does not bring an offering. And [as for] that which we say, "to include an unwitting [offender] like an intentional [offender]," that is [referring to] an unwitting man [being] like an intentional [one]; however, [regarding] the woman, it is necessary that she be an intentional [offender].
